text: When your feet are cold, the nervous system often keeps an anxious mode (this does not apply to hot countries, where cooling the feet pleasantly relaxes). So, in the evening, for 10 minutes immerse your feet in a basin of warm water. Or simply put on warm socks and massage your feet with your thumb, especially the middle of the foot and the heel. While doing this, breathe slowly and deeply. It is very simple, but the effect can be noticeable: the body calms down and you feel good.
